Theme

Conversation, family & daily routines

waste time verb

also I’m wasting my time, waste one’s breath, waste one’s effort, waste time and effort

classical

Traupman 89, 395, 404

tempus perdere

Other words

  • tempus conterere — waste time, wear away the time

    also used · classical · Cic. Rosc. Com. 41: frūstrā tempus conterō (Lewis & Short s.v. frūstrā); Traupman 110, 404

  • operam perdere — waste one’s effort, waste one’s breath

    also used · classical · Plaut. Poen. 332: et oleum et operam perdidī; Traupman 110, 404

Examples

  • Nōlī tempus perdere: calceōs indue.

    Don’t waste time: put your shoes on.composed

  • frūstrā tempus conterō

    I am wasting my timeCic. Rosc. Com. 41 (Lewis & Short)

  • labōrem ac tempora perdere

    to waste time and effortTraupman 404

See also I haven’t got time, pass the time.

SourcesJohn C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, supplied PDF (printed page numbers): p. 89.
